mapper.select:
SELECT cap.product_id, cap.product_number, cap.product_name, cap.business_type, suser.DESCRIPTION as createPerson, ( SELECT fc.company_full_name FROM fnd_company fc WHERE fc.company_id = cap.company_id ) AS company_name, cap.issue_amount, cap.product_currency_code, (select max(times) from ct_abs_product_collection capc where capc.product_id = cap.product_id) as times FROM ct_abs_product cap left join SYS_USER suser on cap.CREATED_BY=suser.USER_ID WHERE cap.company_id = #{request.companyId} and cap.data_class = 'NORMAL' and cap.product_status = 'APPROVED'
and cap.product_number like concat('%',concat(#{productNumber},'%'))
and cap.product_name like concat('%',concat(#{productName},'%'))

SELECT cap.product_id, cap.product_number, cap.product_name, cap.business_type product_business_type, su.description AS create_person, cri.business_type, cri.status as change_status, cri.change_req_date FROM ct_abs_product cap, change_req_info cri,sys_user su
where cri.change_req_id = cap.change_req_id and su.user_id = cri.change_req_user_id and cri.document_type = 'ABS_PRODUCT' and cap.data_class = 'CHANGE_REQ' and cri.status!='CANCEL'
and ((cap.product_number like concat('%',concat(#{productNumber},'%'))) or (cap.product_name like concat('%',concat(#{productNumber},'%'))))
and cri.business_type = #{businessType}
and cri.status in
#{item}
and to_date(#{dateStr},'YYYY-MM-DD') <= cri.change_req_date
AND su.description like '%'||#{createPerson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}||'%'
order by cri.change_req_date desc

select cap.product_id as productId, cap.product_number as productNumber, cap.product_short_name as productShortName, cap.product_name as productName, cap.business_type as businessType, caj.project_english_type as projectEnglishType, caj.project_short_name as projectShortName, cap.issue_amount as issueAmount, -- cap.base_date as baseDate, ( SELECT su.description FROM sys_user su WHERE su.user_id = cap.user_id ) AS createPerson, cap.due_date_begin as dueDateBegin, cap.due_date_end as dueDateEnd, cap.product_level as productLevel, cap.interest_rate as interestRate, cap.change_rate as changeRate, cap.change_amount as changeAmount, cap.makeup_amount as makeupAmount, cap.change_info as changeInfo, cap.asset_change_type as assetChangeType, cap.project_id as projectId, cap.pack_id as packId, cri.status as changeStatus, cri.change_req_id as changeReqId, cri.change_req_date as changeReqDate, cri.change_description as changeDescription from ct_abs_product cap, change_req_info cri, ct_abs_project caj 1=1 and cap.change_req_id = cri.change_req_id and cap.project_id = caj.project_id
and cap.product_id = #{productId}

SELECT ( SELECT count( 1 ) FROM change_req_info cri, ct_abs_product cap WHERE cri.change_req_id = cap.change_req_id AND cap.data_class = 'CHANGE_REQ' AND cri.document_type = cap.document_type AND cri.business_type = 'PRODUCT' and cap.company_id = #{request.companyId} ) AS product_count, ( SELECT count( 1 ) FROM change_req_info cri, ct_abs_product cap WHERE cri.change_req_id = cap.change_req_id AND cap.data_class = 'CHANGE_REQ' AND cri.document_type = cap.document_type AND cri.business_type = 'ASSET' and cap.company_id = #{request.companyId} ) AS asset_count FROM DUAL

SELECT cap.business_type business_type, count( cap.product_id) product_count, sum(cap.issue_amount) issue_amount_sum, (select count(1) from ct_abs_product p where p.data_class = 'NORMAL' and p.company_id = #{request.companyId} ) product_total_count, SUM(cap.issue_amount)-nvl(SUM(apr.due_amount),0) -nvl(SUM(pcd.cash_principal),0)-nvl(SUM(caps.subscribe_amount),0) surplus_amount, ROUND(((SUM(cap.issue_amount)-nvl(SUM(apr.due_amount),0) -nvl(SUM(pcd.cash_principal),0)-nvl(SUM(caps.subscribe_amount),0))/ SUM (cap.issue_amount))*100,2) || '%' surplus_amount_percent FROM ct_abs_product cap LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pr.product_id, SUM(pr.due_amount) due_amount FROM ct_abs_product_repayment pr WHERE pr.cf_item=301 GROUP BY pr.product_id ) apr ON apr.product_id=cap.product_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cd.product_id, SUM(cd.cash_principal) cash_principal FROM ct_abs_product_cash_detail cd join ct_abs_product_collection capc on capc.collection_id=cd.collection_id and capc.data_class='NORMAL' GROUP BY cd.product_id ) pcd ON pcd.product_id=cap.product_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ps.product_id, SUM(ps.subscribe_amount) subscribe_amount FROM ct_abs_product_subscribe ps WHERE ps.subscribe_status='CONFIRM' AND ps.subscribe_type='SELF_HOLDING_SUBSCRIPTION' GROUP BY ps.product_id ) caps ON caps.product_id=cap.product_id WHERE cap.data_class = 'NORMAL' AND cap.company_id = #{request.companyId} AND to_char(cap.product_date,'YYYY')=to_char(sysdate,'YYYY') GROUP BY cap.business_type

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT hsn.notice_id, hsn.notice_message, hsn.notice_datetime, hsn.notice_type, hsn.notice_url, hsn.notice_level, hsn.source_module, hsn.source_event, hsn.source_document_category, hsn.source_document_id, hsn.source_user_id, ( SELECT p.product_name FROM ct_abs_product p WHERE p.product_id = hsn.source_document_id ) AS project_name FROM hls_system_notice hsn WHERE hsn.source_module = 'ABS' AND hsn.SOURCE_EVENT LIKE '%ABS_PRODUCT%' ) v WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ct_abs_product cap WHERE cap.product_id = v.source_document_id AND cap.company_id = #{request.companyId} ) ORDER BY v.notice_datetime DESC

SELECT nvl(sum( t2.due_amount ),0) FROM ( SELECT SUM( ccc.principal ) AS due_amount FROM con_contract_cashflow ccc, ct_abs_product cap, ct_abs_project abj, ct_abs_assets_package caap WHERE cap.project_id=abj.project_id AND abj.pack_id=caap.pack_id AND caap.con_document_category= 'CON_CONTRACT' AND caap.contract_id=ccc.contract_id AND ccc.times<=caap.times_to AND ccc.times>=caap.times_from AND ccc.cf_status = 'RELEASE' AND ccc.cf_item = 1 AND cap.product_id = #{productId} AND ccc.due_date BETWEEN to_date( #{fromDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) AND to_date ( #{toDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) UNION
SELECT SUM( ccc.due_amount ) AS due_amount FROM fct_quotation_cashflow ccc, ct_abs_product cap, ct_abs_project abj, ct_abs_assets_package caap WHERE cap.project_id=abj.project_id AND abj.pack_id=caap.pack_id AND caap.con_document_category= 'FCT_CONTRACT' AND caap.contract_id=ccc.contract_id AND ccc.times<=caap.times_to AND ccc.times>=caap.times_from AND ccc.cf_status = 'RELEASE' AND ccc.cf_item = 54 AND cap.product_id = #{productId} AND ccc.due_date BETWEEN to_date( #{fromDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) AND to_date ( #{toDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) ) t2

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT c.contract_id, c.interest, c.times, c.due_date FROM con_contract_cashflow c, ( SELECT ccc.contract_id, ccc.due_date FROM (select con.contract_id, ( CASE con.renting_frequency WHEN 'YEAR' THEN 12 WHEN 'HALF_A_YEAR' THEN 6 WHEN 'QUARTER' THEN 3 ELSE 1 END ) renting_frequency from con_contract con) co, con_contract_cashflow ccc WHERE co.contract_id = ccc.contract_id and ccc.contract_id IN ( SELECT caap.contract_id FROM ct_abs_product cap,ct_abs_project abj,ct_abs_assets_package caap WHERE cap.project_id=abj.project_id and abj.pack_id=caap.pack_id and cap.product_id = #{productId} AND caap.con_document_category= 'CON_CONTRACT' ) AND ccc.due_date BETWEEN date_add( to_date(#{fromDate},'YYYY-MM-DD'),interval -co.renting_frequency month) and date_add( to_date(#{toDate},'YYYY-MM-DD'),interval co.renting_frequency month) AND ccc.cf_item = 1 ) t1 WHERE c.contract_id = t1.contract_id AND c.due_date = t1.due_date AND c.cf_item = 1
UNION
SELECT c.contract_id, c.due_amount AS interest, c.times, c.due_date FROM fct_quotation_cashflow c, ( SELECT ccc.contract_id, ccc.due_date FROM fct_quotation_cashflow ccc WHERE ccc.contract_id IN ( SELECT caap.contract_id FROM ct_abs_product cap,ct_abs_project abj,ct_abs_assets_package caap WHERE cap.project_id=abj.project_id and abj.pack_id=caap.pack_id and cap.product_id = #{productId} AND caap.con_document_category= 'FCT_CONTRACT' ) AND ccc.due_date BETWEEN to_date( #{fromDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) and to_date( #{toDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) AND ccc.cf_item = 55
) t1 WHERE c.contract_id = t1.contract_id AND c.due_date = t1.due_date AND c.cf_item = 55 ) t2

SELECT nvl(sum( t2.due_amount ),0) FROM (
SELECT SUM( ccc.interest ) AS due_amount FROM con_contract_cashflow ccc, ct_abs_product cap, ct_abs_project abj, ct_abs_assets_package caap WHERE cap.project_id=abj.project_id AND abj.pack_id=caap.pack_id AND caap.con_document_category= 'CON_CONTRACT' AND caap.contract_id=ccc.contract_id AND ccc.times<=caap.times_to AND ccc.times>=caap.times_from AND ccc.cf_item = 1 AND ccc.cf_status = 'RELEASE' AND cap.product_id = #{productId} AND ccc.due_date BETWEEN to_date( #{fromDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) AND to_date ( #{toDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) UNION
SELECT SUM( ccc.due_amount ) AS due_amount FROM fct_quotation_cashflow ccc, ct_abs_product cap, ct_abs_project abj, ct_abs_assets_package caap WHERE cap.project_id=abj.project_id AND abj.pack_id=caap.pack_id AND caap.con_document_category= 'FCT_CONTRACT' AND caap.contract_id=ccc.contract_id AND ccc.times<=caap.times_to AND ccc.times>=caap.times_from AND ccc.cf_item = 55 AND ccc.cf_status = 'RELEASE' AND cap.product_id = #{productId} AND ccc.due_date BETWEEN to_date( #{fromDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) AND to_date ( #{toDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) ) t2
SELECT nvl(sum( c.received_principal + c.received_interest ) ,0) FROM ct_abs_property_contract c WHERE c.product_id = #{productId}

SELECT sum( t2.received_amount ) FROM ( SELECT sum( c.received_amount ) AS received_amount FROM con_contract_cashflow c, ( SELECT ccc.contract_id, max( due_date ) AS due_date FROM con_contract_cashflow ccc WHERE ccc.contract_id IN ( SELECT caap.contract_id FROM ct_abs_product cap,ct_abs_project abj,ct_abs_assets_package caap WHERE cap.project_id=abj.project_id and abj.pack_id=caap.pack_id and cap.product_id = #{productId} AND caap.con_document_category= 'CON_CONTRACT' ) AND to_date( #{formatDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) > ccc.due_date AND ccc.cf_item = 1 GROUP BY ccc.contract_id ) t1 WHERE c.contract_id = t1.contract_id AND c.due_date = t1.due_date AND c.cf_item = 1
UNION
SELECT sum( c.received_amount ) AS received_amount FROM fct_quotation_cashflow c, ( SELECT ccc.contract_id, max( due_date ) AS due_date FROM fct_quotation_cashflow ccc WHERE ccc.contract_id IN ( SELECT caap.contract_id FROM ct_abs_product cap,ct_abs_project abj,ct_abs_assets_package caap WHERE cap.project_id=abj.project_id and abj.pack_id=caap.pack_id and cap.product_id = #{productId} AND caap.con_document_category= 'FCT_CONTRACT' ) AND to_date( #{formatDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) > ccc.due_date AND ccc.cf_item IN ( 54, 55 ) GROUP BY ccc.contract_id ) t1 WHERE c.contract_id = t1.contract_id AND c.due_date = t1.due_date AND c.cf_item IN ( 54, 55 ) ) t2

select t1.* from (SELECT pro.product_id, pro.product_name, pro.product_number, pro.product_date, ( SELECT scvb.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scvb WHERE scb.code = 'ABS_TYPE' AND scb.code_id = scvb.code_id AND scvb.value = cap.business_type ) AS business_type, cap.project_name, cap.project_number, pro.deadline_days, ( SELECT count(1) FROM ct_abs_product_collection capc WHERE capc.product_id = pro.product_id AND capc.remittance_number != '' ) AS remittance_times, pro.product_level, pro.product_status, pro.due_date_end FROM ct_abs_product pro, ct_abs_project cap WHERE pro.project_id = cap.project_id and pro.change_req_id = -1
and cap.project_number like concat('%',concat(#{projectNumber},'%'))
and cap.project_name like concat('%',concat(#{projectName},'%'))
and pro.product_name like concat('%',concat(#{productName},'%'))
and pro.product_status = 'FINISH'
and pro.product_status != 'FINISH' ) t1 1=1
AND t1.business_type IN
#{item}
order by t1.product_date desc
mapper.update: UPDATE ct_abs_product cap SET cap.report_name= ( SELECT cvb.meaning FROM sys_code_b cb JOIN sys_code_value_b cvb ON cb.code_id=cvb.code_id WHERE cb.code='ABS_TYPE' AND cvb.value=cap.business_type) || SUBSTR(cap.product_number,LENGTH (cap.product_number)-1,2) || '-'|| CASE WHEN (nvl(cap.issue_amount,0)/10000 <1 AND nvl(cap.issue_amount,0)/10000>0) THEN nvl(cap.issue_amount,0)/10000 ELSE (nvl(cap.issue_amount,0)/10000) END ||'万'|| to_char(cap.due_date_begin, 'YYYY' ) || '年'|| to_char(cap.due_date_begin, 'mm' ) || '月' || to_char(cap.due_date_begin, 'dd') || '日' WHERE cap.product_id=#{productId}
mapper.select: select nvl(t.income_other_fee,0) income_other_fee from (select ( case #{cfItem} when 910 then sum(nvl(OTHER_FEE, 0)) when 909 then sum(nvl(ACCOUNTANT_FEE, 0)) when 908 then sum(nvl(LISTING_FEE, 0)) when 907 then sum(nvl(EVALUATION_FEE, 0)) when 906 then sum(nvl(RATING_FEE, 0)) when 905 then sum(nvl(LAWYER_FEE, 0)) when 904 then sum(nvl(UNDERWRITING_FEE, 0)) when 903 then sum(nvl(MANAGEMENT_FEE, 0)) when 902 then sum(nvl(HOSTING_FEE, 0)) when 901 then sum(nvl(SERVICE_FEE, 0)))income_other_fee from CT_ABS_PRODUCT_COLLECTION where PRODUCT_ID = #{productId})t
SELECT '-'||nvl(REPLACE(LPAD(MAX(SUBSTR(CAP.PRODUCT_NUMBER, -2, 2)) + 1, 2), ' ', '0'), '01') FROM CT_ABS_PRODUCT CAP WHERE CAP.PROJECT_ID=#{projectId}

SELECT (SELECT cvb.meaning FROM sys_code_b cb JOIN sys_code_value_b cvb ON cb.code_id = cvb.code_id WHERE cb.code = 'ABS_TYPE' AND cvb.value = cap.business_type) business_type, (SELECT DESCRIPTION FROM fnd_company WHERE company_id = cap.company_id) company_name, cap.* FROM CT_ABS_PRODUCT cap where 1=1 and cap.data_class='NORMAL'
and cap.finance_plan_line_id = #{financePlanLineId}

SELECT max(con.due_date) due_date FROM ( SELECT max( ccc.due_date ) AS due_date FROM con_contract_cashflow ccc, ct_abs_product cap, ct_abs_project abj, ct_abs_assets_package caap WHERE cap.project_id=abj.project_id AND abj.pack_id=caap.pack_id AND caap.con_document_category= 'CON_CONTRACT' AND caap.contract_id=ccc.contract_id AND ccc.times<=caap.times_to AND ccc.times>=caap.times_from AND ccc.cf_item = 1 and ccc.cf_status='RELEASE' AND cap.product_id = #{productId} UNION
SELECT MAX( ccc.due_date ) AS due_date FROM fct_quotation_cashflow ccc, ct_abs_product cap, ct_abs_project abj, ct_abs_assets_package caap WHERE cap.project_id=abj.project_id AND abj.pack_id=caap.pack_id AND caap.con_document_category= 'FCT_CONTRACT' AND caap.contract_id=ccc.contract_id AND ccc.times<=caap.times_to AND ccc.times>=caap.times_from AND ccc.cf_item in (54,55) and ccc.cf_status='RELEASE' AND cap.product_id = #{productId} ) con

SELECT nvl(sum( t.due_amount ),0) FROM (
SELECT SUM( ccc.due_amount ) AS due_amount FROM con_contract_cashflow ccc, ct_abs_product cap, ct_abs_project abj, ct_abs_assets_package caap WHERE cap.project_id=abj.project_id AND abj.pack_id=caap.pack_id AND caap.con_document_category= 'CON_CONTRACT' AND caap.contract_id=ccc.contract_id AND ccc.times<=caap.times_to AND ccc.times>=caap.times_from AND ccc.cf_item = 11 AND ccc.cf_status = 'RELEASE' AND cap.product_id = #{productId} AND ccc.due_date BETWEEN to_date( #{fromDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) AND to_date ( #{toDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) UNION
SELECT SUM( ccc.due_amount ) AS due_amount FROM fct_quotation_cashflow ccc, ct_abs_product cap, ct_abs_project abj, ct_abs_assets_package caap WHERE cap.project_id=abj.project_id AND abj.pack_id=caap.pack_id AND caap.con_document_category= 'FCT_CONTRACT' AND caap.contract_id=ccc.contract_id AND ccc.times<=caap.times_to AND ccc.times>=caap.times_from AND ccc.cf_item = 11 AND ccc.cf_status = 'RELEASE' AND cap.product_id = #{productId} AND ccc.due_date BETWEEN to_date( #{fromDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) AND to_date ( #{toDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) ) t
